bio: Close to the town hall, this pretty single-storey building stands out from the urban landscape with its terrace and small vegetable garden. Victor Gaillard and Alice di Cagno (previously at Chatomat in Ménilmontant) are at the helm, enthusiastically sharing their love of good food and their commitment to sustainability. The duo propose a superb lunchtime set menu that is reasonably priced and lets the ingredients speak for themselves: watercress, hazelnut and Pecorino Pepato arancini; pulled veal in sauce blanquette, creamy polenta and button mushrooms; rum semolina cake, poached pear with smoked tea. On the last three days of the week, more sophisticated and creative fare can be sampled in the evening. A small selection of natural and organic wines....
